calculation.expression: -(asset_return_3d_lag1 - cross_sectional_median(asset_return_3d_lag1)) when breadth_decline_lag1 >= max(0.60, rolling_252_median(breadth_decline_lag1)) for two consecutive days
calculation.description: Cross-sectional contrarian three-day return signal activated only after two consecutive extreme-decline-breadth observations; all inputs are lagged or trailing.
